d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne aagami 21 tarikh ko pradhanmantri narendr modi ke bihar daure aur 'nitish setu' ke udghatan ko lekar bayan diya hai. midiya se batchit karte hue mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne is mahasetu ki prishthabhumi aur iske namakran ke karnon par vistar se apni bat rakhi hai.
Mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne kaha ki pradhanmantri narendr modi 21 tarikh ko bihar ki pavitr dharti par 'nitish setu' (pul) ka udghatan karne aur ise janta ko samarpit karne aaenge. iske alava, ve alag-alag vibhagon ke kaee any projekts ka udghatan aur shilanyas bhi karenge.
